attributes.name: Huntsman's Greatsword +2
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Strength or Melee skill + 2d6+2; you may additionally discard this card to add your Strength die +2. If not proficient with weapons, the difficulty of this check is increased by 4. 

Recharge this card to add 2d6 to your Survival check or to your check against a bane that has the Animal trait.
